correctness.rationale: For every real \(s>1\), the exact critical orbit determines a unique parameter curve, with expanding slopes \(s\) and \(D/s^2\). Its primitive Markov adjacency has characteristic polynomial \(z^3-z^2-z-1\), proving constant topological entropy. Direct Frobenius--Perron equations normalize the unique positive step density by primitive expansion. Exact interval integrals and differentiation show \(m(s)=1/2+(s+1)/(DN)\) with strictly negative derivative. The return-chain probabilities \(q_j=s^j/D\) and durations \((3,2,1)\) give the exact relative-entropy identity and equality at \(s=\lambda\). Proof supplies the quantifiers, endpoint limits, and exceptions; 190 distinct rational test cases only supplement it.

value.rationale: The 2023 source explicitly raises theoretical mean tuning for the proposed three-parameter chaotic map. This result selects the canonical, not arbitrary, length-four postcritical Markov curve, gives an exact analytic one-to-one calibration for every mean in (1/2,11/18), and identifies a striking entropy separation: identical tribonacci topological complexity, an exactly KL-quantified unique entropy optimum, and vanishing physical entropy toward a geometrically well-defined limit. These calibrated map-specific statistics and equality boundary are concrete structural information beyond numerical parameter sweeps, though the general entropy-flexibility phenomenon was known.
